name: LinkedIn Deck Desk
tagline: Turn a newsletter into a checked LinkedIn carousel and queue it in Buffer
description: Takes a newsletter issue or a news story and rebuilds it as a slide carousel sized for LinkedIn. Before anything is published it reviews the images and charts it produced, and only a pass clears the deck for the queue. A recurring series can then sit ready to post on its own.
author: pareshdesai
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
